experiments.name: Phase 2 - Bigram Contextual Scorer
experiments.exit_gate_criterion: ≥5% relative error reduction on held-out test fixtures
experiments.conclusion: Bigram language model from dictionary data lacks discriminatory power for homophone disambiguation. Recommend proceeding to SLM-based reranker (Phase 3) or training on larger corpora.

experiments.name: Tiny-LLM Reranker Scaffold
experiments.description: External scorer protocol and benchmark harness for evaluating 200M–0.5B local tiny LLMs as candidate-constrained rerankers. The scaffold is verified with mock scorers but no real model has been benchmarked yet. Protocol v1.1 adds candidate-only output validation.

candidate_validation.note: Candidate validation is implemented but not exercised by current fixtures — none supply a 'candidates' field.

next_steps: Benchmark quantized 200M–0.5B models through the protocol
Compare against deterministic reranker on held-out Taiwan fixtures
Gate: must beat deterministic reranker before promotion to Phase 3

experiments.name: Evaluator-based Candidate Request Export
experiments.description: Adds --slm-request-output CLI flag to the C++ contextual evaluator, generating JSONL request files with per-position candidate slots from the ReadingGrid baseline segmentation. The output schema is compatible with the Python SLM reranker experiment runner, enabling candidate-only output validation (candidate_validation.exercised=true). Includes a fix for build_scorer_request to pass baseline_output from fixture instead of empty string.
next_steps: Implement llama.cpp wrapper scorer for real model evaluation
Benchmark quantized 200M–0.5B models on the three fixture suites with candidate validation
Gate: any candidate SLM must beat deterministic reranker on held-out Taiwan fixtures before Phase 3

experiments.name: Persistent External Scorer Protocol
experiments.description: Adds a persistent scorer protocol (--persistent-scorer-command) to the SLM reranker experiment runner. Keeps the scorer process alive for all fixture cases, communicating over stdin/stdout pipes. Eliminates per-case subprocess spawn overhead (~430x latency reduction at p95: 19ms to 45us). Mock scorer supports --persistent mode for protocol verification. select(2)-based timeout; Unix-only.
experiments.verification: Syntax check + self-test (includes persistent path) + dry-run + per-case mock + persistent mock + privacy check + git-diff-check
next_steps: Implement llama.cpp wrapper scorer with persistent protocol support
Benchmark quantized 200M–0.5B models on the three fixture suites using persistent protocol
Gate: any candidate SLM must beat deterministic reranker on held-out Taiwan fixtures before Phase 3

experiments.name: Local Tiny-LLM Scorer Wrapper Scaffold
experiments.description: Local tiny-LLM scorer wrapper scaffold with --provider command/ollama, --dry-run-baseline, and --model-manifest parameter enforcement. Adds local_llm_scorer.py and model_manifest.example.json to Tools/SLMRerankerExperiment/. Verified via dry-run-baseline persistent protocol on 234 candidate-exported fixture cases: 0 fallbacks, candidate_validation.exercised=true, 0 violations. No real 200M–0.5B model was benchmarked; the 5 installed Ollama models are all 9B+.
next_steps: Benchmark a real 200M–0.5B model through --provider command with llama-cli or similar
Benchmark through --provider ollama with a pre-installed tiny model (e.g., qwen2.5:0.5b)
Compare against deterministic reranker on held-out Taiwan fixtures using candidate-validated output
Gate: any candidate SLM must beat deterministic reranker before promotion to Phase 3

experiments.name: SLM Reranker Benchmark Suite Runner
experiments.description: Orchestrated benchmark suite runner that evaluates baseline, deterministic reranker, and SLM reranker across three canonical fixture sets. Produces aggregate metrics, relative error reduction, and gate evaluation.
next_steps: Benchmark a real 200M-0.5B model through the suite
Gate: SLM must beat deterministic reranker before Phase 3
